hero_signature: Two-column editorial split. Left: ultra-thin uppercase pulsing-dot status pill, Playfair Display 3-line headline with italic middle word, Outfit body, animated arrow CTA bottom-border-link, 3-up icon trust pillars under a hairline. Right: 500x600 parallax cursor-tracking 3D showcase containing a grayscale luxury interior photo (background), a glassmorphic spec checklist card peeking out the right edge (midground), 10 floating glass bubble particles (foreground), and an 'Active Sterility Index' chip pinned bottom-left. The whole right column rotates a few degrees on mouse-move via Framer Motion useSpring with perspective:1200.

section_flow.notes: Sticky bg-[#0F1115]/80 backdrop-blur. Tiny ringed 'A' tile + tracking-[0.35em] uppercase Playfair wordmark, mid-nav anchor links in tracking-[0.2em] uppercase Outfit, right-side 'Book Consultation' rounded-full border-pill with Compass icon.

Full-width 600px rounded-2xl viewport. Bottom layer: clean photo with saturate boost; top layer: same photo with grayscale + brightness reduction, clipped via clipPath inset from the left percentage. White 0.5px vertical handle with circular drag puck at center and ↔ glyph. Top labels: 'BEFORE: Dull & Muted' (right) and 'AFTER: Sterile Luxury' (left). Drag/hover-to-compare. 4-stat grid below.

12-col bento: card1=7, card2=5, card3=5, card4=7. Each card is rounded-2xl bg-[#161920] with brushed-metal hover overlay (linear-gradient diagonal 1c202a→161920→13161c + repeating-1px-pattern at mix-blend overlay). Click to open a right-side drawer (Framer Motion spring) showing description, duration/intensity grid, and surgical specs list. Backdrop is bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-md.
Dark bg-[#0B0C0E] section with a centered Sparkles icon, italic Playfair pull-quote, hairline divider, and tiny tracking-[0.3em] uppercase 'The Aura Manifesto' attribution.
Compact name/email/inquiry form on dark cards (bg-[#161920] inputs, white-on-black submit pill 'Initialize Consultation' with tracking-[0.15em] uppercase).
4-col: brand+body, Locations (with MapPin), Concierge (PhoneCall + email + response-standard), Compliance copy. Bottom strip with copyright and three policy links.

notable_features: Brushed-metal background-gradient + 2px-repeating-line overlay on cards (mix-blend overlay)
Framer Motion useSpring parallax rotateX/rotateY on hero showcase column
Glassmorphic spec checklist card overhanging the hero's right edge
Pointer-captured drag on transformation slider (clipPath inset transition)
Asymmetric 12-col bento services with 7/5 + 5/7 row layout
Side-drawer modal pattern via Framer Motion AnimatePresence with spring damping=30/stiffness=200
Outfit ultra-thin uppercase microtype at tracking-[0.25em] and font-size 9-11px
Italic Playfair pull-quotes used for centerpiece copy moments
Custom 6px scrollbar with translucent white thumb
Editorial dark off-black bg-[#0F1115] paired with section variant bg-[#0B0C0E]
motion_vocabulary: Hero showcase: useSpring rotate driven by mouse position with perspective:1200 transform-style:preserve-3d
Floating bubble particles: 3s+ ease-in-out y-bobble loops, staggered delays
Bento card hover: brushed-metal overlay fade-in 500ms + subtitle reveal slide-up
Service drawer: spring damping=30 stiffness=200 slide from right
Animated arrow CTA: Framer Motion infinite x:[0,4,0] over 1.5s ease-in-out
prefers-reduced-motion: reduce → all keyframe/transition durations clamped to 0.01ms
tailwind_extras_inline_css: .brushed-metal-bg (diagonal gradient + ::after with repeating-1px-line + mix-blend overlay + 80% opacity). Custom 6px scrollbar (track #0F1115, thumb rgba(255,255,255,0.1) → 0.2 on hover). Tokenized via @theme directives: --color-background, --color-background-alt, --color-card-bg, --color-card-border, --color-text-primary, --color-text-secondary, --color-text-muted, --font-sans (Outfit), --font-serif (Playfair Display).
